title: Better Hit the Nail on the Head than Beat around the Bush: Removing Protected Attributes with a Single Projection

bias_targets.methodology: Measured using multiple metrics on word embeddings and downstream tasks, including: linear classifier accuracy for gender predictability (linear guarding), Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT) scores for stereotypical associations, Bias-by-neighbor analysis (evaluating the percentage of gender-biased words among the 100 nearest neighbors), clustering metrics (V-measure) to see if embeddings separate into male/female clusters, and True Positive Rate Gap (TPR-GAP) to measure disparity in predicting occupations from biographies of men versus women.
